name: Chai
description: Smug-teary stickman waving, caption 'CHAI'. Nigerian 'chai!' — mix of pity, awe, 'see this one', and relatable pain.
whenToUse: When the story is touching, slightly painful, extra, or 'see as life be': chai, hian, e be like say, 'this one pain me', a close call, or funny suffering. Softer than na_wa; more feeling than judgement.
whenNotToUse: Not for dry facts, greetings, or hard disagreement. Skip real tragedy where a meme would be rude.
